title: Status
description: One status effect from the standard set (03-GAME-DESIGN rev. 2 §3.5, the 27-row table), owning its numbers: when it ticks, how it stacks, what it does each tick or while held, and what cleanses it. One file per status under content/statuses/<id>.json; the id must be one of common's status enum and the folder must hold every enum value.

kind.description: The table's Kind column: dot/hot tick damage or healing; control removes or limits actions; buff/debuff move stats; mark raises damage taken or lowers healing received (Mark, Smite, Wither); state is a flag with its own rule (Veil).

element.description: The element whose hits apply it as their mark (§3.4: Fire → Burn, Frost → Chill, Lightning → Shock, Poison → Poison, Holy → Smite, Shadow → Wither); null for statuses no element owns.

tickAt.description: When per-turn effects resolve (§3.5: DoTs and HoTs at the holder's turn start; durations count down at turn end).

magnitudeOf.description: What the per-tick number is a percentage of (the table's 'Starting rule'): hitDamage — the applying hit's damage (Bleed 25%, Burn 20%); maxHp — the holder's max HP (Poison 3%, Regen X%); attack — the applier's Attack; fixed — the skill sets the number (Shield X). null for statuses with no magnitude.

percent.description: The per-tick magnitude as a percentage of magnitudeOf, per stack (Bleed 25, Poison 3, Burn 20); null when magnitudeOf is null or fixed.

tickDamageType.description: The damage type a DoT tick deals (Bleed physical slash, Burn fire, Poison poison); null for everything that does not tick damage.

ignoresDefense.description: A tick that skips the Defense step of the damage formula (§3.5: Bleed and Poison).

stacking.description: refresh: a new application resets the duration; stack: adds a stack up to maxStacks; max: keeps the stronger of the two.

maxStacks.description: 1 for statuses that do not stack.

durationDefault.description: Turns, when the applying effect gives no duration; null for an instant (Daze) or an until-condition status (Grab, Veil).

endsWhen.description: The condition that ends an until-condition status, as the table words it ('freed', 'used', 'broken'); null for a timed status.

effects.description: What the status does beyond its magnitude: stat lines while held (Chill: speed −25%), extra rules (Shock chains) and custom hooks. A dot/hot's tick is magnitudeOf + percent, not a line here.

upgradesTo.description: The status a second application becomes (§3.4: Chill → Freeze); null for none.

cleansedBy.description: Cleanse tags that remove it (every debuff has a cleanse and every buff a strip, §3.5); skills and items carry the matching tags.

appliesEnergyDelta.description: Timeline energy added to the holder when applied (§3.5: Daze −500, Freeze/Stun/Petrify −1000); 0 for none.

skipsActionChance.description: Chance the holder loses its action each turn (§3.5: Fear 50; Stun 100); 0 for none.

immunityRoles.description: Monster roles that never take this status (06 §7: bosses and hunters shrug off Petrify, Grab, Web, Root, Fear).

bossBecomes.description: The status a boss or hunter takes instead (06 §7: Stun → Daze, Freeze → Chill); null when it applies as is or never.
